x-bump-note: RE-VENDOR: claude-klabauter vendors this schema byte-exact. Every property annotated x-status: proposed is a D2 extension (or D2 addendum) awaiting claude-klabauter's accept/counter reply; the base properties are the baton draft. The file carries no x-schema-version on purpose: schema_version (const 1) is the contract version, and an x-schema-version key would enrol the file in schema-version-pins.json.
description: Declarative stage graph of one research or staff-session pipeline, read by claude-klabauter's dispatch.emit --pipeline route to emit a receipted Workflow. The manifest names stages, agents, models, templates and ordering; it carries no prompt text. Read-side rules not expressible in JSON Schema: (1) pipeline is unique fleet-wide and equals the manifest file's <pipeline> stem; (2) every depends_on and every {{stage.<id>.output}} / return reference names a stage declared earlier in stages[]; (3) stages[] is listed in execution order and the Workflow's return value is the return of the last-listed stage that ran; (4) {{item}} is legal only in a stage whose fan_out is an object, {{item.<field>}} only in a stage whose fan_out.over is subject.<field>, {{subject}} only when subjects_mode or per_subject is in play; (5) a fanned stage's output must contain {{item}}, a per_subject stage's output {{subject}}; (6) no value is an absolute path; (7) a fan_out.over return reference on a fanned producer stage resolves to the de-duplicated union of that field across the producer's items; (8) produces_brief is legal only on stages[0], whose fan_out is absent or none; (9) halts_unless requires the stage's schema to be an inline object whose required names that field, whose properties type it boolean, and whose properties carry remedy (array of string).

pipeline.description: The --pipeline key. Unique fleet-wide; equals the <pipeline> stem of <pipeline>.manifest.yaml.

description.description: One line for the emitted Workflow's meta.description.

subjects_mode.description: D2 extension. Present: the whole stage graph runs once per inputs.subjects entry, in sequence, with {{subject}} bound. Absent: subjects, if given, are fanned only through stages that set fan_out: per_subject.

brief.description: Path of the EM's scope artifact (scope.md, scout-brief.md, strategy.md). Bound to {{brief}}.

subjects.description: List of subject keys. Bound to {{subject}}.

scratch_dir.description: Run scratch directory. Bound to {{scratch_dir}}; the engine derives one when absent.

flags.description: Flag name to its allowed values. A flag selects stages through when; it is not a template token.

lists.description: D2 extension. Named list inputs a stage fans over with fan_out.over: inputs.<name>. kind strings: a list of scalar strings, each bound to {{item}}. kind roster: a list of {slug, agent_type} objects; the slug is bound to {{item}} and agent_type_from reads agent_type.

stages.description: Stages in execution order. Ids are unique within the manifest.

returnRef.description: A field of a stage's schema-forced return, e.g. stage.verify.return.challenged.

phase.description: D2 addendum. Title of the Workflow phase the stage belongs to; stages sharing a title share one meta.phases entry. Absent: the stage id.

agent_type.description: coordinator:<agent>, or a harness type such as general-purpose.

agent_type_from.description: D2 extension. A roster list input; each item's agent_type is the roster entry whose slug equals the item. Replaces agent_type for a stage whose agents differ per item.

model.description: Absent: the agent definition's pinned model (repo-scout is pinned haiku and never takes an override).

effort.description: D2 addendum. Per-call effort override (repo's disk-gate agent runs at low).

template.description: POSIX path relative to the manifest file.

over.description: A producer stage's return list (base draft; an empty list skips the stage), a named inputs list (D2 extension), or a list field of each subject (subject.<field>; subjects may be objects, the list is fixed at emit time). Each element is bound to {{item}}; an over-subject element that is an object exposes its fields as {{item.<field>}}.

fan_out.description: none: one agent. per_subject: one agent per subject. {over}: one agent per list element.

max_concurrent.description: D2 extension. Chunk a fanned stage into parallel() groups of at most this many. Optional; absent, the stage is bounded only by the Workflow tool's own agent cap.

flag.description: A declared inputs.flags name; the stage runs when it equals the equals value.

return.description: A boolean field of a prior stage's return; the stage runs when it equals the equals value (default true).

nonempty.description: A list field of a prior stage's return; the stage runs when it is non-empty.

equals.description: Comparison value for flag and return.

when.description: D2 extension. Run condition, evaluated when the stage's dependencies have returned. A stage whose condition is false is skipped and counts as returned. Three forms: a flag, a return boolean, a non-empty return list.

optional.description: D2 addendum. A failure of this stage does not stop the run; later stages proceed without its output.

produces_brief.description: The stage writes the run's scope artifact: its output path is rebound to {{brief}} for every later stage, replacing the inputs.brief path. Legal only on stages[0] with fan_out absent or none.

halts_unless.description: Name of a boolean field of this stage's own inline schema. When the stage returns it false, the run halts after this stage and returns the stage's remedy list.

web_caller.description: The stage's agents call WebSearch or WebFetch. Informational: it sets no concurrency ceiling.

output.description: Placeholder path under scratch_dir that {{stage.<id>.output}} resolves to.

schema.description: Return JSON schema, forced on the stage's agents. A path relative to the manifest, or (D2 addendum) an inline object.
